WITH category_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_quantity,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_cost_diff
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  WHERE ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
    AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND ili.product_quantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
),
mean_cost_diff AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_cost_diff) as overall_mean
  FROM category_stats
),
filtered_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.avg_quantity,
    cs.avg_cost_diff,
    cs.avg_cost_diff - mcf.overall_mean as excess
  FROM category_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN mean_cost_diff mcf
  WHERE cs.avg_cost_diff > mcf.overall_mean
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_quantity) as final_avg_quantity,
  AVG(avg_cost_diff) as final_avg_cost_diff,
  AVG(excess) as final_avg_excess
FROM filtered_categories
